turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and perfect for a warm Texas day. It must be nice to have a relaxing day after a long week. How have things been at the logistics firm lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Work as an account coordinator has been pretty hectic with some end-of-quarter shipping rushes, so I really needed this weekend to just unplug and recharge.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I completely understand. It's so important to have that separation from work. Aside from climbing, do you think you'll get some guitar practice in today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, definitely. I think after I finish lunch, I'll tune up my guitar and work on a new song I've been trying to learn.
